name: MCTAR7
tagline: Compact AMD Ryzen desktop PC with dual HDMI and full-featured Type-C
description: MCTAR7 offers configurable AMD Ryzen processors, Radeon graphics, DDR4 memory, dual HDMI and full-featured Type-C connectivity. NVMe and SATA M.2 storage, Gigabit Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2 support everyday desktop deployments.

specifications.label: Memory

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: 1 x M.2 PCIe 3.0 x 4 2280 SSD + 1 x M.2 NGFF SATA 2242 SSD; Supports up to 2TB

specifications.label: Rear I/O - Ports
specifications.value: 1 x RJ45 1.0G Network interface; 1 x Type-C (Full-featured); 2 x HDMI 1.4; 1 x DC 19V; 1 x audio jack; 2 x USB3.0
